description: Bridge Context Gate SessionStart hook — reminds agents to pull 7-day organizational context (bridge_context_pull / brg context) and report a 🟢/🟡/🔴 Alignment Check before substantive work begins.

hooks.command: printf '%s\n' '[Bridge Context Gate] Before substantive work, run `bridge_context_pull` (or `brg context --days 7 --json` via `skills/bridge-context/SKILL.md`), distinguish spoken claims (Rail 2, never treat uncorroborated talk as done) from verified proof (Rail 3-5), and open with a 🟢 Green / 🟡 Yellow / 🔴 Red Alignment Check against active tasks, resolved decisions, and FleetLease file locks. When encountering stakeholder/promo trade-offs (e.g. for kate, doc), use `brg decide propose --to kate,doc --mode advisory` (Default-Unless-Vetoed) in unattended/promo runs or offer to dispatch a 1-Click Decision Card in interactive sessions.'
